name: Commerce Tabby
description: Drupal Commerce offsite payment gateway for Tabby, the MENA/Saudi buy-now-pay-later (instalments) provider. Redirects the shopper to Tabby's hosted checkout and confirms the outcome on the return leg and via an auto-registered webhook, in both cases re-fetching the payment from Tabby's authenticated API (GET v2/payments/{id}) and proceeding only on status CLOSED/AUTHORIZED. Supports authorize, auto-capture, capture and refund. Single gateway plugin 'tabby' extending OffsitePaymentGatewayBase; version 1.0.0-beta5.
project_description:
Commerce Tabby module implements the Tabby payment processing service (Tabby) in Drupal Commerce.

 Installtion instructions: 
 * You can install this module via Composer (recommended), or

* clone it from drupal.org Git repo, or

* Download the module from drupal.org
